tools.name: Read
tools.description: Read file contents from the filesystem. Supports offset/limit for partial reads.

tools.name: Write
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file with content. Creates parent directories automatically.

tools.name: Edit
tools.description: Edit file with precise text replacement. Replaces first occurrence of exact text.

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Find files matching a glob pattern (e.g., **/*.ts, src/*.js).

tools.name: Grep
tools.description: Search for text pattern in files. Returns matching lines with line numbers.

tools.name: WebFetch
tools.description: Fetch and extract readable content from a URL. Returns markdown or plain text.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description: Execute shell commands. Supports PowerShell on Windows, bash on Unix.

tools.name: Remember
tools.description: Store a memory in the temporal memory system. Classifies and stores in appropriate hall.

tools.name: Recall
tools.description: Query the temporal memory system. Supports wing/room filtering and semantic search.
